note: Known, deliberately tolerated silent-success markers. scripts/silent-success-scan.sh scans the ENABLED families in prevention-rules/silent-success-rules.json and FAILS on any occurrence NOT listed here. A hit is covered when some entry's "file" equals the hit's repo-relative path AND that entry's "marker" is a substring of the hit line — so a NEW occurrence (different file, or a different marker in the same file) still fails. Every entry should name the work item that removes it: an allowlist without expiry dates is just a list of bugs you agreed to keep. Do NOT add new production-simulating markers; fix the code instead.

entry_shape.file: repo-relative path of the file containing the marker
entry_shape.marker: substring of the offending line that identifies it
entry_shape.reason: why it is tolerated for now
